title: Sequence arithmetic parsers in Parsec
description: Parsec is a Haskell parsing library. You can read this reference sketch as a sequence of smaller parsers whose results are combined.

steps.description: The import supplies Parsec's operations. expr's signature describes a parser over String input that returns a Double.
The do block parses one term, then zero or more operator-and-term pairs. foldl combines those results from left to right.
applyOp defines the displayed addition and subtraction cases. Its final pattern handles the remaining operator case.
term follows the same structure using factors and multiplication or division symbols. The trailing ellipsis leaves its local operation definitions unspecified.
